title: Questions 191-195 refer to the following announcement, memo, and e-mail.
passage_1:
A New Chapter for Meridian Systems

Meridian Systems is proud to introduce MERIDIAN FLOW, which can handle many repetitive office procedures automatically. Although we are primarily recognized for our platforms that stop outsiders from reaching confidential company databases, we are eager to expand into the field of workflow automation. MERIDIAN FLOW was developed under the direction of Dr. Alina Petrova. Before coming to our company, she spent more than 12 years conducting advanced automation studies at the Redmoor Institute of Technology.

We are currently offering the following monthly licenses:

  • 40 users or fewer: $900 per month
  • 41 to 90 users: $1,500 per month
  • 91 to 140 users: $2,300 per month
  • More than 140 users: $3,100 per month

Visit www.meridiansystems.com/flow for more information.

MEMO

To: All Department Heads
From: Tobias Grantham
Date: June 10
Subject: MERIDIAN FLOW

Beginning next month, Aldervale Group will start using MERIDIAN FLOW. Since we will be paying $3,100 per month for access to this platform, I want to be certain that all of you know how to use it effectively. I have therefore arranged for representatives from Meridian Systems to come to our office and deliver training. The workshop dates are as follows:

  • July 6: Overview of core functions (Yolanda Pierce)
  • July 7: Drafting proposals with automated templates (Simon Adeyemi)
  • July 8: Scheduled invoice processing and alerts (Grace Nakamura)
  • July 9: Screening job applications automatically (Victor Salois)

Each workshop will begin at 9 A.M. in the east briefing room and run for three hours.

To:Tobias Grantham <t.grantham@aldervalegroup.com>
From:Helena Ruiz <h.ruiz@aldervalegroup.com>
Date:July 11
Subject:Implementation Plan

Dear Mr. Grantham,

I am supposed to submit my plan for implementing MERIDIAN FLOW into my department’s routine procedures tomorrow, but I must travel to Ashcroft unexpectedly to see a supplier. Could I send it to you on July 15 instead? I also wanted to mention that the training delivered by Meridian was extremely useful. I particularly valued the session by Naomi Feldt, who replaced Simon Adeyemi because of a sudden scheduling conflict. She gave me numerous ideas for speeding up the way we prepare client proposals.

Sincerely,
Helena Ruiz
Procurement Manager, Aldervale Group
